content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to use [product_name] software on a tablet device? I want to create a dashboard using the IP address provided by the [product_name] program. Any tablet, whether Android or Apple, would be suitable. If anyone has previously attempted this, I would appreciate your insights. Thank you in advance.

Hello, Thank you for your reply. Is there a simpler solution? We want to run this on a touch screen tablet, but the available Windows tablets use Windows RT, which isn't mentioned as compatible. Android and Apple tablets also don’t appear to be supported. Regarding Linux, I'm not familiar with it, but is it feasible to install that OS on a touch screen tablet? Thank you for your response. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are uncertain about the compatibility of [product_name] software with popular tablet devices including Android, iOS, and Windows RT versions. The lack of clear guidance or support for these platforms creates confusion and makes it challenging for users who want flexible dashboard access. Device and OS limitations restrict the use of touch-based tablets for this purpose.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate being able to easily access and control the [product_name] dashboard from mainstream tablets, regardless of whether the tablet runs Android, iOS, or Windows RT. They are looking for a straightforward method to operate the dashboard on common tablet devices with touch functionality.
